Subject.name: Cascade Partners Investor Letter - Q2 2026 Notes

row.Body:
Key Takeaways

  • The Fund returned 19.9% net in Q2 versus 15.2% for the benchmark, bringing year-to-date net to 22.6%.

  • In July the Fund declined 15.0% gross and 12.9% net as momentum unwound.

Performance Summary

  • Top five winners by net return: Cascade Industrial (CSDI) 12.4%, Harborline Group (HBRL) 9.1%, Ridgeway Power (RDGW) 7.8%.

  • Top five detractors by net return: Sablefish Energy (SBLF) 6.2%, Kestrel Aerospace (KSTL) 4.9%.

  • Several positions are now underwritten to three-year IRRs of 30-40%.

Cascade Industrial (CSDI)

  • Down over 15% in July, including 7.6% on Q2 earnings, which we attribute to conservative guidance rather than deterioration.

  • We model earnings compounding more than 20% annually through 2030.
